description: Shared product catalog. Deliberately NOT tenant-scoped in this sample dataset — modeled as a catalog shared across all tenants, which is a realistic pattern for e.g. a franchise/marketplace model where tenants sell from a common product list.

columns.name: sku
columns.description: Stock keeping unit, unique per product

ddl:
CREATE TABLE text_to_sql_node.products (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  sku TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  category TEXT NOT NULL,
  unit_price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL
);
